[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Arac''' was a young officer who served aboard the ''[[FarStar]]'' as a [[Medic/Legends|medic]]. He treated [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]] after the ship was hit by a [[lightstorm]] in the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]].
